card.name: Word right after a possessive pronoun
card.fires_on: Possessive words like his, your, their, or the noun right after them, in general prose about people and their belongings or relations. Also fires on 'of' after 'that' or 'those' in comparisons.

modes.label: Possessive pronoun
modes.description: The word his or your itself, as a person's attribute is about to be named.
modes.example: Archbishop of Paris, was shot in<< his>> attempt to quell the insurrection.

modes.label: Noun after possessive
modes.description: A noun or 'own' right after his, your, or their.
modes.example: sitting at his<< table>> counting money when he looked out of

modes.label: Of in comparison
modes.description: The word 'of' after that or those, referring back to a possessed thing.

card.plain: It marks spots where a 'his/your/their' phrase is underway, such as 'in his attempt' or 'at his table'.
